title: Volcanoes of Ethiopia
intro: 10 volcanoes of Ethiopia, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Bishoftu Volcanic Field
